name: Pinch
description:
A jointed arm swinging in and its claw shutting. Spider Hand was the one weapon with nothing to say: up to eight arms reaching and biting on their own clocks, in silence.

`swing` is the arm on its way in, a short band of noise rising from `$shell.up` to `$grit` as it speeds up, so the bite is announced a breath before it lands. `snap` is the claw closing: two hard clicks five milliseconds apart, the two halves of a pincer meeting, bandpassed at `$gust` with a `band` Q so they are chitin and not paper. `ring` is a single short sine at `$grit` under them, gone in fifteen milliseconds — the hardness of the shell, short enough that it never becomes a note. Nothing low: a claw is small, and the hit the bite lands is already the weight.

Ships three takes and sits low, because eight arms can bite inside the same second.
